findings.region: Right-hand btn-group-vertical (the `.btn-check` stack), middle label "Column center"
findings.seen: The checked label "Column center" is not filled. It shows cyan text on the page surface with only a cyan border, the same as its unchecked siblings "Column left" and "Column right". No label in that stack reads as selected. The same specimen is filled in vertical-group--light-1280.png and vertical-group--light-390.png. It is also filled in the page frame check-group-focus--dark-1280.png, and the horizontal check group is filled in check-group-checked--dark-1280.png.
findings.expected: Bootstrap _buttons.scss rule `.btn-check:checked + .btn` paints `--bs-btn-active-bg`. For `.btn-outline-primary`, mixins/_buttons.scss `button-outline-variant` sets `$active-background: $color`, so the checked label must render as a solid primary fill with contrast text in both colour modes. Veneer's own `.btn-check:checked + .btn` rule in src/styles/components/_button.scss produces that fill in the other frames. So the checked state looks lost in this capture, not missing from the stylesheet. Referral to the Orchestrator: find out whether the dark element capture of this scenario reset the `column-alignment` radio's checked state, or whether this is a real state defect.

findings.region: First row of filled role buttons: Primary, Secondary, Warning, Info, Danger, Success
findings.seen: Warning is a burnt-orange fill (about #bb4d00) with white text. Info is a deep teal-blue (about #0069a8) with white text. Primary is a deeper, more saturated blue (about #0841ea). Secondary is a slate blue-grey (about #45556c). Danger (about #c10007) and Success (about #008236) are also shifted. Outline variants in the second row follow the same hues.
findings.expected: Bootstrap _buttons.scss runs `@each $color, $value in $theme-colors` into `button-variant($value, $value)`. That gives Warning #ffc107 with black text and Info #0dcaf0 with black text, because `color-contrast()` picks dark text for both. It also gives Primary #0d6efd, Secondary #6c757d, Danger #dc3545, and Success #198754. The Warning and Info buttons change both hue and text polarity. guides/veneer.md § Departures records these as `tokenized` rows. This finding reports them as visible departures for reconciliation, not as unrecorded drift.
